name: Seaside BBQ
notes: "Seaside BBQ" appears to be a weekend-only (Sat/Sun 11am-7pm per Instagram) BBQ pop-up associated with Seaside Market, a grocery store at 2087 San Elijo Ave, Cardiff - one door off the listed address, 2093 San Elijo Ave. Seaside Market's own SinglePlatform deli menu (Cardiff Crack tri-tip, Korean BBQ items, sandwiches) is priced but belongs to the grocery store's regular deli counter, not confirmed as the same offering as the weekend "Seaside BBQ" pop-up. Listed website (seasidemarket.com/contact/) carries no menu or prices.
blocked: weekend BBQ pop-up, identity/address does not cleanly match a priced source (nearest priced menu belongs to Seaside Market's regular deli, address off by one door number)

name: Donut Bros
notes: DoorDash schema.org @type:Menu JSON-LD, deduped name+price. Address confirmed via the multi-location city page (doordash.com/es/city/el-cajon-ca/b/donut-bros-215148/) which lists store id 33535299 as "1558 N Magnolia Ave, El Cajon" - matching this restaurant's address exactly; the OTHER DoorDash/Postmates/Uber Eats store ids for "Donut Bros" resolve to a different branch at 524/526 N 2nd Street and were excluded (same-name other-branch trap). "Popular Items" section holds items (bagel melts, croissants, variety boxes) not duplicated under Regular Donut/Featured Item/Beverages, so kept rather than dropped as a carousel; count (24) is well clear of the 79/91 truncation-signature range.
